{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers AND exclude those with age = -1
converted_customers = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(mean_age_converted)"}
